referents.why: 'to them' (autois), masculine plural, is the crowd the release is for; ochlos is singular but collective, so the plural pronoun agrees in sense
'he might release', subjunctive with an implied subject, is Pilate: the releasing is his custom (15.6); Barabbas is the object of the release, not its doer
referents.category: implied subject of a purpose clause

links.why: hina with the subjunctive: the chief priests stirred the crowd so that Pilate would release Barabbas
links.category: purpose after an act of persuading
